nphi.title: TESA II – Trials of Excellence in Southern Africa II

nphi.title: LabTrain 2.0 – Sustainable drug quality control and laboratory standards in West and South-East Africa
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)

nphi.summary: Strengthens national drug quality control laboratories to meet international standards and secure access to safe medicines.

nphi.title: ARILAC – Advancing Regional Integrated Laboratory Capacity for AMR Control
nphi.actor: Africa CDC with African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM)
nphi.with: European Union (Team Europe Initiative on Sustainable Health Security); Ethiopian Public Health Institute and national AMR reference laboratories
nphi.summary: Four-year EU-supported One Health laboratory initiative launched May 2026 to strengthen integrated laboratory-based AMR surveillance and lab capacity in eight AU member states.

nphi.title: SPhIRhA – Strengthening Public Health Institutes for Resilience in Health in Africa
nphi.actor: Public Health Agency of Sweden
nphi.with: Africa CDC; national public health institutes of the four countries
nphi.summary: Sida-funded four-year project, coordinated by the Swedish agency together with Africa CDC, to strengthen four African NPHIs with a particular focus on sexual and reproductive health and rights.

nphi.title: China–Zimbabwe schistosomiasis elimination project and National Center for International Research on Tropical Diseases
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
nphi.with: Zimbabwe National Public Health Institute (ZNPHI); Ministry of Health and Child Care
nphi.summary: China-funded schistosomiasis elimination pilot in Shamva district. In 2023 NIPD and its Zimbabwean partner signed an MoU and opened a China–Zimbabwe tropical disease research centre, NIPD's sixth overseas centre.

nphi.title: IANPHI Africa Regional Network
nphi.actor: IANPHI Africa Regional Network (co-chair: Institut National de Santé Publique, Guinea)
nphi.with: INSP Guinea; INSP Cabo Verde (co-chair); NICD South Africa; INS Mozambique; NCDC Nigeria; ZNPHI Zambia
nphi.summary: Network of 47 African NPHIs (founded 2013) that works with Africa CDC on NPHI and legal frameworks, scorecards and workforce development, and tracks member NPHIs' progress toward legal status.

nphi.title: CDC Zimbabwe country office
nphi.actor: US CDC
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Child Care (MoHCC); National Public Health Institute (in establishment); national microbiology and TB reference laboratories; Zimbabwe FETP
nphi.summary: CDC's Zimbabwe office (2000) supports MoHCC on HIV/TB (PEPFAR), lab accreditation, surveillance and FETP (since 1993), and is helping establish a National Public Health Institute.

nphi.title: EU support to establish Zimbabwe's first National Public Health Institute
nphi.actor: European Union (DG INTPA)
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Child Care Zimbabwe; WHO
nphi.summary: EUR 4.2 million four-year EU investment, implemented with WHO, to set up Zimbabwe's NPHI and connect it with African and European public health institutes that run similar models.

nphi.title: Institution-Based Network on China–Africa Cooperation for Schistosomiasis Elimination
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
nphi.with: University of Yaoundé; Theodor Bilharz Research Institute (Egypt); African schistosomiasis programmes
nphi.summary: Network of Chinese and African institutions working on schistosomiasis elimination, hosted by NIPD. Its 7th annual meeting was held in Haikou in 2022.

nphi.summary: Strengthened African regulators in evaluating marketing authorisation applications and supported African Medicines Agency harmonisation.

nphi.summary: Built regulatory capacity for vaccine clinical trial oversight and AEFI pharmacovigilance in sub-Saharan Africa.

nphi.summary: Train-the-trainer regulatory capacity building for medicines against infectious diseases.

nphi.title: Southern Africa summit on establishing and strengthening NPHIs

nphi.with: Africa CDC; US CDC; IANPHI; NPHIs of Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique (INS), Namibia, South Africa (NICD) and Zimbabwe
